_meta.name: Fraud reports
_meta.source: Federal Trade Commission, Consumer Sentinel Network Data Book 2024
_meta.note: Annual report count by type, 2001–2024, from 2024_CSN_Number_of_Reports_by_Type.csv. Not unique victims or a population incidence rate. Multiple report types can apply; category totals need not equal the unduplicated combined count.
_meta.breaks: Contributing organizations, public awareness, and classifications change over time. National Do Not Call Registry complaints excluded; reporting volume is not underlying crime incidence.
_meta.method: 2024_CSN_Number_of_Reports_by_Type.csv: Year, Fraud; not the combined Report_Count table.
